Verses of the blind Syrian poet and sceptic of the eleventh century, in English by Ameen Rihani.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Abu al-Ala al-Maarri (973–1057), Luzumiyat (Arabic), translated by Ameen Rihani (1876–1940), 1918. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution.
